queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Prefeitura de Franca cadastral-map page, the municipal Cadastro Fiscal Imobiliário notice, and the public Cadastro Imobiliário service. No anonymous first-party parcel feature API or downloadable native parcel polygon layer was verified.

queries.query: Franca SP cadastro imobiliário mapa cadastral lotes prefeitura oficial
queries.result: A busca em português confirmou a Prefeitura de Franca as municipal custodian: its Cadastro Fiscal Imobiliário covers municipal urban and rural properties, its public consultation accepts street and number and displays cadastral facts, and the official map page publishes a 2023 cadastral map. No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.

officialSources.observation: Official municipal page lists MAPA CADASTRAL DE FRANCA - 2023 in PDF and DWG among city maps. This establishes an official cadastral cartographic publication, not a parcel feature API.
Official municipal notice states that the Cadastro Fiscal Imobiliário is maintained by the Prefeitura de Franca and records cadastral data for urban and rural properties.

Official service page describes public cadastral consultation by street and property number, with cadastral number, property type and area fields; it requires image text/CAPTCHA in the documented workflow and does not expose geometry.

requests.outcome: Official page loaded in bounded web access and exposed the 2023 cadastral map PDF/DWG links. No machine-readable parcel schema, CRS, native parcel identity, or feature endpoint was exposed. A separate local curl attempt timed out after 20 seconds; no retry escalation was used.
Official notice loaded and identified the municipal Cadastro Fiscal Imobiliário and linked consultation service. No parcel geometry was returned.

Official service instructions loaded. The documented public route requires street, five-digit property number, and image text; no anonymous geometry query or safe bounded feature response was attempted.
